issuer.summary: sUSDe is issued and governed by the same Ethena entity as USDe, so its Issuer score and basis are inherited. Ethena's operating record, attestations and monitoring support the score; concentrated ENA governance and the absence of direct USDe-holder representation constrain it.
issuer.summary_source: October 29 shared BM evidence and RiskAnalyst targeted report/rationale review; last full verification October 11. Issuer score and its original generation date are unchanged. Current fee-switch activation and independent offchain custody are not verified.
facts: The historical ENA fee-switch proposal replaced the earlier Reserve-Fund-first parameters. Its stated supply milestones are not proof of current activation.

The original published $4.847948164bn average used 340 September 30–October 14 observations despite an October 28 computation timestamp. The repaired source now reports insufficient_history with null average and milestone; a complete current 14-day window remains unavailable.
Current spot supply cannot replace the required average or establish governance activation; authoritative activation evidence remains outstanding.
The historical proposal vote recorded 17.786m votes from 88 voters and no opposition; one account exceeded quorum alone. This update is not a new governance or authority audit.
USDe and sUSDe holders do not vote in ENA governance solely by holding these assets.
